meta.source: jmbh/EmotionTimeSeries (open experience-sampling data archive by Jonas Haslbeck), studies: Bringmann et al. 2013, Bringmann et al. 2016, Fisher et al. 2017, Fried et al. 2021, Rowland & Wenzel 2020. Vrijen et al. 2018 and Wright et al. 2017 not used (reuse on request / shared elsewhere).
meta.what: One row per person: number of prompts, mean and SD of negative affect (items rescaled 0-1 within study), lag-1 autocorrelation of negative affect, mean positive affect, negative-emotion differentiation (1 - mean inter-item correlation of negative items). No raw responses, no ids.
